instruction: A cinematic fashion portrait photograph in a close-up shot at eye-level, set in a minimalist indoor studio with a plain beige wall. On the left, the red-haired woman in the beige striped blazer (R1) stands in profile facing right, turning her head to look back toward the camera with a neutral expression. Directly behind her, the blonde woman in the white t-shirt (R2) stands close, facing left in profile with her head tilted down. Their bodies are pressed close together in a back-to-front pose. Harsh, direct sunlight streams from the upper left, casting sharp diagonal shadows across the subjects and the background wall, creating a warm, muted color palette.
